reports.headline: Unexplained Attacks Surround Local Resident
reports.body: Several people have reportedly been injured while approaching the same resident at the cottage {dir} of the village {dist} during moments of distress. Witnesses insist nobody else was nearby, although several described hearing what sounded like a woman's voice immediately before each incident.

reports.headline: Neighbours Keep Their Distance From the Cottage
reports.body: {name} raised {their} voice at the young resident of the cottage {dir} of here {dist} and was thrown across the yard by nothing at all. Since then nobody goes near. The resident has asked everyone to stay away, and cries at night, and someone answers.
